2014_spells.revivify.description: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.
2014_spells.revivify.effectSummary: Change a target: that creature returns to life with 1 hit point
2014_spells.revivify.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point; This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts. The effect happens immediately and then ends.
